data.body: Independent exact-SHA documentation review of 04e85471bb72ac9655c90af4b374cb044b7d0949 (parent a46c50e063bb61e5f91e8684c10986f224d74d00): CHANGES REQUIRED before push. Stage 1 spec/convention compliance fails in tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py. Edited lines 1 and 5 use `real` as a value adjective (`real ticket-store Git history`, `real material functions`), which docs/documentation-policy.md explicitly bans in new or edited maintained text. Also make the line 3 mechanism unambiguous: `pruned review sidecars` can be read as Git-unreachable objects, while `git rev-list --objects --all` recovers sidecars removed from the current tree but retained in reachable history. Required correction: describe ticket-store Git history without `real`, say `production material functions`, and say sidecars removed from the current tree remain discoverable. Keep the block strictly shorter than its immutable parent. No Gerrit push occurred; all mechanical and focused checks otherwise passed. A new exact commit SHA requires a fresh independent review.
